Subject: Your cheque bounce matter - CC/127/2025

Dear Mr. Kapoor,

Thank you for meeting us on 14 December 2025 about your dispute with M/s Menon Traders. As we understand it, the drawer stopped the cheque with a stop-payment instruction.

Our advice is to argue that a stop-payment instruction does not protect the drawer when the debt is admitted. Please collect the written acknowledgement of the debt and the stop-payment memo and send copies to this office. We will pursue the full claim of ₹37,30,000.

Regards,
Adv. Zubin Contractor
